planReviewContext.description: decompose-plan precedence order puts the explicit --overview-task-id CLI flag LAST after parent plan metadata and parent prd.json. Both Copilot and Codex flag this: a CLI override must win over discovered metadata, otherwise users cannot intentionally override stale embedded values. The doc inside the plan (§3.2 of the doc template) must reorder precedence so the flag is first.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Reorder the precedence list in the doc template's §3.2 to: (1) explicit --overview-task-id flag, (2) parent plan metadata block, (3) parent prd.json's overviewTaskId. Update both the doc template inside draft-plan.md and any acceptance criterion that depends on the order.

planReviewContext.description: The doc tells convert-to-ralph-prd to read valid IDs from <repo_root>/plans/overview-data.js, but Ralph is a project-agnostic plugin and the same doc says elsewhere that 'the Ralph plugin doesn't know about overview-data.js'. Hardcoding a codexu-specific path conflicts with the plugin's design and will fail / misbehave in repos without that file. Make the lookup optional and config-driven, or fall back to a free-form prompt when the file is absent.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: In the doc template's §3.1, reword the interactive prompt: 'If the repo has an overview-data file at a path discoverable via .ralph/overview-config.json (or any consumer-defined config), offer those IDs as a prompt convenience; otherwise prompt for a free-form string. Always allow skip / null.' Add a back-compat note that the prompt-list lookup is opt-in and the flag/free-form prompt is the canonical path.
